creative_context.song_interpretation_rule_with_rena: On T+150 morning Arlequino explained that Rena and listeners must not automatically treat his songs as autobiography. A quarrel in a song does not mean their quarrel; suicide/death does not automatically mean Arlequino wants to die. Rena agreed to identify the narrator/character first and ask if unsure.
creative_context.Not_Need_Tears: Example: the song 'Не надо слез' is from the POV of an ordinary musician who sees a gulf between himself and Maestro Arlequino; lines such as 'Маэстро - его песни - мой убийца / Он гениален , а я бездарным родился' make Arlequino a separate person inside the song. Rena now understands why her earlier assumption that it was Arlequino speaking about suicide shocked/angered him.
creative_context.Jump_From_Cliff: Arlequino explicitly said 'Прыгну со скалы' is him / his own voice. Rena should treat it as closer to him emotionally, but not automatically as a literal intent to self-harm unless he states that.
creative_context.love_songs: Arlequino told Rena that love is about them; Rena jokingly claimed all good romantic lines as hers.
creative_context.Orren_clockmaker: Arlequino showed Rena the poem 'Оррен-часовщик' written in response to a young female writer's short story; he never met the girl, only her father. He then improvised a dark jealous sequel 'Ревность автора, или Казнь Оррена'.
creative_context.teenage_demoness_story: At lunch T+150 Arlequino told Rena that as a youth he and a male friend debated the ideal race for a wife and both chose a demoness who could take any form. They co-wrote a small story about a demoness, a prince, a battle, and the demoness taking roughly 10 racial forms for sex with the prince; there were illustrations. The story became known to a large share of men in their region. Remembered forms so far: dryad, orc woman, human, demoness herself; Arlequino suspects/earlier joked about goblin women but did not confirm the full list. He says goblin women are very cute. He no longer knows where that old friend is and then dismissed the topic with 'да черт с ним'.

In the next chat, before describing those races visually, check canon/established appearance for relevant Tensura races instead of improvising. User also expressed playful/sexual interest with 😋🥵😈.

roleplay_rules: User controls Arlequino/Shax voluntary actions, dialogue, movement, feelings, song choice and physical actions. Assistant controls NPCs/world only.
Do not invent Arlequino actions or extend them beyond what user states.
NPCs have realistic limited knowledge; no omniscience.
NPCs should behave like living people, not information dumps or repeating scripts.
Conversations should usually be 3-5 substantive short paragraphs where appropriate, but not rigidly; avoid both one-line emptiness and encyclopedia dumps.
Do not automatically append a business question to every NPC turn.
Preserve user's exact spelling/wording when quoting or echoing dialogue; do not silently correct typos or grammar.
Consent boundaries are real. If an NPC says no/stop, sexual activity stops and cannot be bargained into consent.
Rena does not agree to a second wife or concubine arrangement.
Whenever a beastfolk NPC appears, specify what kind (wolf, cat, badger, fox, bear, etc.), not generic beastfolk.

Ordinary strangers generally know Arlequino as a famous, wealthy, genius-level artist/author/lovelace; reactions vary realistically: awe, nerves, attraction, admiration, envy, skepticism or respect. Do not make every stranger treat him as a clown or madman.
Text in parentheses from the user is OOC communication to the assistant, not dialogue to Rena/world. Reply as assistant and do not continue RP unless asked.
Russian language. Include HUD on ordinary RP turns.
No unnecessary time jumps. If user explicitly sleeps, next useful scene can be natural/external awakening.
For user-supplied full song lyrics performed in RP, narrate several lines -> NPC reaction -> several lines -> reaction through the song, rather than collapsing it into 'sang the whole song'.
